ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous patches localized at the distal ends of both lobes. The left lobe features a large, irregular white region with internal black mottling. The right lobe displays a smaller, distinct white patch at the tip. The central fluke area is predominantly uniform low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation at the central convergence point, estimated at a wide angle exceeding 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate frequency serrations along the trailing edges; the left lobe displays more pronounced, sharper peaks compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical outward sweep with a distinct concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered high-contrast white circular spots (rosettes) primarily distributed across the black pigmented regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, short white linear markings visible on the medial-posterior section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant encrustation of brownish-white organic matter (barnacles) localized on the outer tip of the right lobe; irregular, jagged pixel boundary at the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Single distinct black circular void within the white pigmentation field of the distal left lobe.
